scope: Tracks enum variants and tuple/record payload shapes for every public enum in src/syntax/arena.rs and src/syntax/node.rs; registry builtin type labels and type/parameter enums; semantic, lowered, indexed type, control, and effect enum schemas; the live LoweredValue enum and exactly-one encoded, alias, custom, or rejected codec route for every variant; effect and stream-stage companion tables; managed-resource enums and complete rule rows; raw instruction, pattern, driver, value, and pipeline-stage schemas, including payload types, ordinals, exclusions, and routing metadata. It excludes full grammar productions, arbitrary dynamic declarations, host behavior, and proof/conformance results.
